verses.geez:
ወልህቀ ፡ ኢየሱስ ፡ ወኀለፈ ፡ መዋዕሊሁ ፡ ወይቤሎ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለኢየሱስ ፡ ናሁ ፡ ኀለፈ ፡ መዋዕሊከ ፡ ለከ ፡
                  ወተርፈት ፡ ምድር ፡ ብዝኅት ፡ ዘይትወረሱ ።
verses.translation: And Joshua was old and very advanced in years; and the Lord said to Joshua, Thou art advanced in years, and there is much land left to inherit.

translations.lxx: And Joshua was old and very advanced in years; and the Lord said to Joshua, Thou art advanced in years, and there is much land left to inherit.
translations.kjv: Now Joshua was old and stricken in years; and the LORD said unto him, Thou art old and stricken in years, and there remaineth yet very much land to be possessed.
translations.ron: Fiind Iosua bătrân şi înaintat în zile, a zis Domnul către dânsul: "Iată tu ai îmbătrânit şi eşti în vârstă înaintată, dar pământ de luat în moştenire a mai rămas încă mult.
translations.grk: Καὶ Ἰησοῦς πρεσβύτερος προβεβηκὼς τῶν ἡμερῶν· καὶ εἶπε Κύριος πρὸς Ἰησοῦν, σὺ προβέβηκας τῶν ἡμερῶν, καὶ ἡ γῆ ὑπολέλειπται πολλὴ εἰς κληρονομίαν.

verses.geez: ወዛቲ ፡ ይእቲ ፡ ምድር ፡ እንተ ፡ ተርፈት ፡ ደወሎሙ ፡ ለፍል[ስጥኤ]ም ፡ ወዘጌሲሪ ፡ ወዘከናኔዎን ፤
verses.translation: And this is the land that is left: the borders of the Phylistines, the Gesirite, and the Chananite,

translations.lxx: And this is the land that is left: the borders of the Phylistines, the Gesirite, and the Chananite,
translations.kjv: This is the land that yet remaineth: all the borders of the Philistines, and all Geshuri,
translations.ron: Pământul care a mai rămas de luat în moştenire este acesta: ţinuturile Filistenilor şi toată tara Gheşurului şi a Canaanului.
translations.grk: Καὶ αὕτη ἡ γῆ καταλελειμμένη· ὅρια Φυλιστιεὶμ, ὁ Γεσιρὶ, καὶ ὁ Χαναναῖος,

verses.geez:
እምነ ፡ በድው ፡ ዘመንገለ ፡ ገጸ ፡ ግብጽ ፡ እስከ ፡ ደወሎሙ ፡ ለአቃሮን ፡ ዘመንገለ ፡ ፀጋሞሙ ፡ ለአሞሬዎን ፡
                  ዘይትኌለቍ ፡ ለኀምስቱ ፡ በሓውርተ ፡ ፊልስጢእም ፡ ለጋዛ ፡ ወለአዛጦን ፡ ወለአስቀሎን ፡ ወለጌቴዎን ፡ ወለአቃሮን ፡
                  ወለኤዌዎን ።
verses.translation: from the wilderness before Egypt, as far as the borders of Accaron on the left of the Chananites the land is reckoned to the five principalities of the Phylistines, to the inhabitant of Gaza, and of Azotus, and of Ascalon, and of Geth, and of Accaron, and to the Evite;

translations.lxx: from the wilderness before Egypt, as far as the borders of Accaron on the left of the Chananites the land is reckoned to the five principalities of the Phylistines, to the inhabitant of Gaza, and of Azotus, and of Ascalon, and of Geth, and of Accaron, and to the Evite;
translations.kjv: From Sihor, which is before Egypt, even unto the borders of Ekron northward, which is counted to the Canaanite: five lords of the Philistines; the Gazathites, and the Ashdothites, the Eshkalonites, the Gittites, and the Ekronites; also the Avites:
translations.ron: De la Sicor, care este la răsărit de Egipt, până la hotarele Ecronului, la miazănoapte, se socotesc cele cinci căpetenii filistene: Gaza, Aşdod, Ascalonul, Gat şi Ecronul.
translations.grk: ἀπὸ τῆς ἀοικήτου τῆς κατὰ πρόσωπον Αἰγύπτου ἕως τῶν ὁρίων Ἀκκαρὼν ἐξ εὐωνύμων τῶν Χαναναίων προσλογίζεται ταῖς πέντε σατραπείαις τῶν Φυλιστιείμ, τῷ Γαζαίῳ, καὶ τῷ Ἀζωτίῳ, καὶ τῷ Ἀσκαλωνίτῃ, καὶ τῷ Γετθαίῳ, καὶ τῷ Ἀκκαρωνίτῃ, καὶ τῷ Εὐαίῳ,

verses.geez:
እምነ ፡ ቴመን ፡ ወኵሎ ፡ ምድረ ፡ ከናአን ፡ ዘቅድመ ፡ ጋዛ ፡ ወሲዶናሂ ፡ እስከ ፡ ጣፌቅ ፡ እስከ ፡ አድዋሊሆሙ ፡
                  ለአሞሬዎን ።
verses.translation: from Thæman even to all the land of Chanaan before Gaza, and the Sidonians as far as Aphec, as far as the borders of the Amorites.

translations.lxx: from Thæman even to all the land of Chanaan before Gaza, and the Sidonians as far as Aphec, as far as the borders of the Amorites.
translations.kjv: From the south, all the land of the Canaanites, and Mearah that is beside the Sidonians unto Aphek, to the borders of the Amorites:
translations.ron: Apoi ţara Heveilor: tot pământul Canaan şi Maara Sidonienilor, de la Teman până la Afec şi până la hotarele Amoreilor.
translations.grk: ἐκ Θαιμὰν καὶ πάσῃ γῇ Χαναὰν ἐναντίον Γάζης, καὶ οἱ Σιδώνιοι ἕως Ἀφὲκ, ἕως τῶν ὁρίων τῶν Ἀμοῤῥαίων,

verses.geez:
ወኵሎ ፡ ምድረ ፡ ገልየድ ፡ ዘፊልስጢእም ፡ ወኵሎ ፡ ሊባኖን ፡ እምነ ፡ ሠርቀ ፡ ፀሐይ ፡ ወእምነ ፡ ገልጋላ ፡ ዘመትሕተ
                  ፡ ደብረ ፡ አኤርሞን ፡ እስከ ፡ ምብዋኦ ፡ ለኤመት ።
verses.translation: And all the land of Galiath of the Phylistines, and all Libanus eastward from Galgal, under the mountain Aermon as far as the entering in of Emath;

translations.lxx: And all the land of Galiath of the Phylistines, and all Libanus eastward from Galgal, under the mountain Aermon as far as the entering in of Emath;
translations.kjv: And the land of the Giblites, and all Lebanon, toward the sunrising, from Baalgad under mount Hermon unto the entering into Hamath.
translations.ron: De asemenea ţinutul filistean Ghebla şi tot Libanul, spre răsăritul soarelui, de la Baal-Gad, de la poalele muntelui Hermon până la intrarea Hamatului.
translations.grk: καὶ πᾶσαν τὴν γῆν Γαλιὰθ Φυλιστιεὶμ, καὶ πάντα τὸν Λίβανον ἀπὸ ἀνατολῶν ἡλίου ἀπὸ Γαλγὰλ ὑπὸ τὸ ὄρος τὸ Ἀερμὼν ἕως τῆς εἰσόδου Ἐμὰθ,

verses.geez:
ኵሎ ፡ እለ ፡ ይነብሩ ፡ ውስተ ፡ አድባር ፡ እምነ ፡ ሊባኖስ ፡ እስከ ፡ ሙዓለ ፡ ሴሬት ፡ ዘማይም ፡ ዘፎሜም ፡ ኵሎ ፡
                  ሲዶና ፡ እለ ፡ አነ ፡ ኣጠፍኦሙ ፡ እምቅድመ ፡ ገጾሙ ፡ ለእስራኤል ፡ በከመ ፡ እቤ ፡ ለከ ።
verses.translation: every one that inhabits the hill country from Libanus as far as Masereth Memphomaim. All the Sidonians, I will destroy them from before Israel; but do thou give them by inheritance to Israel, as I charged thee.

translations.lxx: every one that inhabits the hill country from Libanus as far as Masereth Memphomaim. All the Sidonians, I will destroy them from before Israel; but do thou give them by inheritance to Israel, as I charged thee.
translations.kjv: All the inhabitants of the hill country from Lebanon unto Misrephothmaim, and all the Sidonians, them will I drive out from before the children of Israel: only divide thou it by lot unto the Israelites for an inheritance, as I have commanded thee.
translations.ron: Pe toţi locuitorii muntelui de la Liban până la Misrefot-Maim, pe toii Sidonienii să-i pierzi de la faţa fiilor lui Israel pământul lor să-l împarţi lui Israel prin sorti, cum ti-am poruncit.
translations.grk: πᾶς ὁ κατοικῶν τὴν ὀρεινὴν ἀπὸ τοῦ Λιβάνου ἕως τῆς Μασερὲθ Μεμφωμαὶμ. Πάντας τοὺς Σιδωνίους, ἐγὼ αὐτοὺς ἐξολοθρεύσω ἀπὸ προσώπου Ἰσραήλ· ἀλλὰ διάδος αὐτὴν ἐν κλήρῳ τῷ Ἰσραὴλ, ὃν τρόπον σοὶ ἐνετειλάμην.

verses.geez: ወይእዜኒ ፡ ክፍሎሙ ፡ ዛተ ፡ ምድረ ፡ ወአስተዋርሶሙ ፡ ለትስዐቱ ፡ ሕዝብ ፡ ወለመንፈቀ ፡ ሕዝብ ፡ ዘመናሴ ።
verses.translation: And now divide this land by lot to the nine tribes, and to the half tribe of Manasse.

translations.lxx: And now divide this land by lot to the nine tribes, and to the half tribe of Manasse.
translations.kjv: Now therefore divide this land for an inheritance unto the nine tribes, and the half tribe of Manasseh,
translations.ron: Aşadar la cele nouă seminţii şi la jumătate din seminţia lui Manase, împarte-le moştenire prin sorţi pământul acesta: de la Iordan până la marea cea mare de la apus să-l dai lor şi marea cea mare să fie hotar.
translations.grk: Καὶ νῦν μέρισον τὴν γῆν ταύτην ἐν κληρονομίᾳ ταῖς ἐννέα φυλαῖς, καὶ τῷ ἡμίσει φυλῆς Μανασσή. Ἀπὸ τοῦ Ἰορδάνου ἕως τῆς θαλάσσης τῆς μεγάλης κατὰ δυσμὰς ἡλίου δώσεις αὐτήν· ἡ θάλασσα ἡ μεγάλη ὁριεῖ.

verses.geez:
እምነ ፡ ዮርዳንስ ፡ እስከ ፡ ባሕር ፡ ዐቢይ ፡ ዘመንገለ ፡ ዐረበ ፡ ፀሐይ ፡ ይሁቦሙ ፡ ወትከውኖሙ ፡ ወሰኖሙ ፡ ባሐር
                  ፡ ዐቢይ ።
verses.translation: From Jordan to the great sea westward thou shalt give it them: the great sea shall be the boundary. But to the two tribes and to the half tribe of Manasse, to Ruben and to Gad Moses gave an inheritance beyond Jordan: Moses the servant of the Lord gave it to them eastward,

translations.lxx: From Jordan to the great sea westward thou shalt give it them: the great sea shall be the boundary. But to the two tribes and to the half tribe of Manasse, to Ruben and to Gad Moses gave an inheritance beyond Jordan: Moses the servant of the Lord gave it to them eastward,
translations.kjv: With whom the Reubenites and the Gadites have received their inheritance, which Moses gave them, beyond Jordan eastward, even as Moses the servant of the LORD gave them;
translations.ron: Căci celelalte două seminţii: a lui Ruben şi Gad şi jumătate din seminţia lui Manase au primit partea de la Moise, dincolo de Iordan, spre răsăritul soarelui, cum le-a dat Moise sluga Domnului,
translations.grk: ταῖς δυσὶ φυλαῖς, καὶ τῷ ἡμίσει φυλῆς Μανασσή, τῷ Ῥουβὴν, καὶ τῷ Γὰδ ἔδωκε Μωυσῆς ἐν τῷ πέραν τοῦ Ἰορδάνου· κατʼ ἀνατολὰς ἡλίου δέδωκεν αὐτῷ Μωυσῆς ὁ παῖς Κυρίου,

verses.geez:
ለእልክቱ ፡ ክልኤቱ ፡ ነገድ ፡ ለሮቤል ፡ ወለጋድ ፡ ወለመንፈቀ ፡ ነገደ ፡ መናሴ ፡ ወሀቦሙ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ በማዕዶተ ፡
                  ዮርዳንስ ፤
verses.translation: from Aroer, which is on the bank of the brook of Arnon, and the city in the midst of the valley, and all Misor from Mædaban.

translations.lxx: from Aroer, which is on the bank of the brook of Arnon, and the city in the midst of the valley, and all Misor from Mædaban.
translations.kjv: From Aroer, that is upon the bank of the river Arnon, and the city that is in the midst of the river, and all the plain of Medeba unto Dibon;
translations.ron: De la Aroer, care e pe malul râului Arnon, cetatea cea din mijlocul văii şi toată câmpia Medeba până la Dibon,
translations.grk: ἀπὸ Ἀροὴρ, ἥ ἐστιν ἐπὶ τοῦ χείλους χειμάῤῥου Ἀρνών, καὶ τὴν πόλιν τὴν ἐν μέσῳ τῆς φάραγγος, καὶ πᾶσαν τὴν Μισὼρ ἀπὸ Μαιδαβάν·

verses.geez:
ዘመንገለ ፡ ሠረቀ ፡ ፀሐይ ፡ ወሀቦሙ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ ቍልዔሁ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ እምነ ፡ አሮኤር ፡ እንተ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ማዕዶተ
                  ፡ ፈለገ ፡ አርኖን ፡ ወሀገር ፡ እንተ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ማእከለ ፡ ቈላት ፡ ወኵሉ ፡ ሚሶር ፡ እምነ ፡ [ሜ]ዳቦን ።
verses.translation: All the cities of Seon king of the Amorites, who reigned from Esebon to the coasts of the children of Ammon;

translations.lxx: All the cities of Seon king of the Amorites, who reigned from Esebon to the coasts of the children of Ammon;
translations.kjv: And all the cities of Sihon king of the Amorites, which reigned in Heshbon, unto the border of the children of Ammon;
translations.ron: Precum şi toate cetăţile lui Sihon, regele Amoreilor, care a domnit în Heşbon, până la hotarele fiilor lui Amon,
translations.grk: Πάσας τὰς πόλεις Σηὼν βασιλέως Ἀμοῤῥαίων, ὃς ἐβασίλευσεν ἐν Ἐσεβὼν ἕως τῶν ὁρίων υἱῶν Ἀμμῶν·

verses.geez: ኵሉ ፡ አህጉረ ፡ ሴዎን ፡ ንጉሠ ፡ አሞሬዎን ፡ ዘነግሠ ፡ በሔሴቦን ፡ እስከ ፡ ደወሎሙ ፡ ለደቂቀ ፡ ዐሞን ፤
verses.translation: and the region of Galaad, and the borders of the Gesirites and the Machatites, the whole mount of Aermon, and all the land of Basan to Acha.

translations.lxx: and the region of Galaad, and the borders of the Gesirites and the Machatites, the whole mount of Aermon, and all the land of Basan to Acha.
translations.kjv: And Gilead, and the border of the Geshurites and Maachathites, and all mount Hermon, and all Bashan unto Salcah;
translations.ron: Şi Galaadul, ţinutul Gheşur şi al Maacatienilor, tot muntele Hermon şi tot Vasanul până la Salca;
translations.grk: Καὶ τὴν Γαλααδίτιδα, καὶ τὰ ὅρια Γεσιρὶ, καὶ τοὺς Μαχατὶ, πᾶν ὄρος Ἀερμὼν, καὶ πᾶσαν τὴν Βασανίτιν ἕως Ἀχά·

verses.geez: ወለገላአድ ፡ ወለደወሎሙ ፡ ለጌሲሪ ፡ ወለማኬጢ ፡ ወለኵሉ ፡ አድባረ ፡ አኤርሞን ፡ ወኵሎ ፡ ባሳን ፡ እስከ ፡ አካ ።
verses.translation: All the kingdom of Og in the region of Basan, who reigned in Astaroth and in Edrain: he was left of the giants; and Moses smote him, and destroyed him.

translations.lxx: All the kingdom of Og in the region of Basan, who reigned in Astaroth and in Edrain: he was left of the giants; and Moses smote him, and destroyed him.
translations.kjv: All the kingdom of Og in Bashan, which reigned in Ashtaroth and in Edrei, who remained of the remnant of the giants: for these did Moses smite, and cast them out.
translations.ron: Tot regatul lui Og al Vasanului, care a domnit în Aştarot şi în Edrea. Acesta mai rămăsese din Refaimi, pe care Moise i-a bătut şi i-a alungat".
translations.grk: Πᾶσαν τὴν βασιλείαν Ὢγ ἐν τῇ Βασανίτιδι, ὃς ἐβασίλευσεν ἐν Ἀσταρὼθ καὶ ἐν Ἐδραΐν· οὗτος κατελείφθη ἀπὸ τῶν γιγάντων, καὶ ἐπάταξεν αὐτὸν Μωυσῆς, καὶ ἐξωλόθρευσε.

verses.geez:
ኵሎ ፡ መንግሥቶ ፡ ለአግ ፡ ዘባሳን ፡ ዘነግሠ ፡ በኤድራይን ፡ ወበአስጣሮት ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ዘተርፈ ፡ እምነ ፡ ደሞሙ ፡
                  ለእለ ፡ ያርብሕ ፡ ወቀተሎ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ [ወአጥፍኦ ፡] ፡ ወ[ኢያ]ጥፍእዎሙ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ለጌሲሪ ፡ ወለመካጢ ፡
                  ወለከናኔዎን ፡ እለ ፡ ውስቴቶሙ ፡ [ወ]ይነብር ፡ ንጉሠ ፡ ጌሲሪ ፡ ወመካጢ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ እስከ ፡ ዮም ፡
                  ወእስከ ፡ ዛቲ ፡ ዕለት ።
verses.translation: But the children of Israel destroyed not the Gesirite and the Machatite and the Chananite; and the king of the Gesiri and the Machatite dwelt among the children of Israel until this day.

translations.lxx: But the children of Israel destroyed not the Gesirite and the Machatite and the Chananite; and the king of the Gesiri and the Machatite dwelt among the children of Israel until this day.
translations.kjv: Nevertheless the children of Israel expelled not the Geshurites, nor the Maachathites: but the Geshurites and the Maachathites dwell among the Israelites until this day.
translations.ron: Dar fiii lui Israel n-au vrut să piardă pe Gheşureni şi pe Maacatieni şi până în ziua de astăzi locuieşte regele din Gheşur şi al Maacatienilor în mijlocul lui Israel.
translations.grk: Καὶ οὐκ ἐξωλόθρευσαν οἱ υἱοὶ Ἰσραὴλ τὸν Γεσιρὶ, καὶ τὸν Μαχατὶ, καὶ τὸν Χαναναῖον· καὶ κατῷκει βασιλεὺς Γεσιρὶ καὶ ὁ Μαχατὶ ἐν τοῖς υἱοῖς Ἰσραὴλ ἕως τῆς σήμερον ἡμέρας.

verses.geez:
እንበለ ፡ ነገደ ፡ ሌዊ ፡ እለ ፡ ኢነሥኡ ፡ መክፈልቶሙ ፡ እስመ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ አምላከ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ውእቱ ፡
                  መክፈልቶሙ ፡ በከመ ፡ ይቤሎሙ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ወከማሁ ፡ ተከፈሉ ፡ በከመ ፡ ከፈሎሙ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ ለደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ፡
                  በ[አራቦ]ት ፡ ዘሞአብ ፡ በማዕዶተ ፡ ዮርዳንስ ፡ ዘመንገለ ፡ ኢያሪኮ ።
verses.translation: Only no inheritance was given to the tribe of Levi: the Lord God of Israel, he is their inheritance, as the Lord said to them; and this is the division which Moses made to the children of Israel in Araboth Moab, on the other side of Jordan, by Jericho.

translations.lxx: Only no inheritance was given to the tribe of Levi: the Lord God of Israel, he is their inheritance, as the Lord said to them; and this is the division which Moses made to the children of Israel in Araboth Moab, on the other side of Jordan, by Jericho.
translations.kjv: Only unto the tribe of Levi he gave none inheritance; the sacrifices of the LORD God of Israel made by fire are their inheritance, as he said unto them.
translations.ron: Numai seminţiei lui Levi nu i-a dat Iosua moştenire, căci jertfele şi prinoasele Domnului Dumnezeului lui Israel sunt partea ei, cum i-a zis Domnul.
translations.grk: Πλὴν τῆς φυλῆς Λευὶ οὐκ ἐδόθη κληρονομία· Κύριος ὁ Θεὸς Ἰσραὴλ, οὗτος κληρονομία αὐτῶν, καθὰ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Κύριος· καὶ οὗτος ὁ καταμερισμὸς, ὃν κατεμέρισε Μωυσῆς τοῖς υἱοῖς Ἰσραὴλ ἐν Ἀραβὼθ Μωὰβ ἐν τῷ πέραν τοῦ Ἰορδάνου κατὰ Ἱεριχώ.

verses.geez: ወወሀቦሙ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ ለነገደ ፡ ሮቤል ፡ በበ ፡ ሕዘቢሆሙ ።
verses.translation: And Moses gave the land to the tribe of Ruben according to their families.

translations.lxx: And Moses gave the land to the tribe of Ruben according to their families.
translations.kjv: And Moses gave unto the tribe of the children of Reuben inheritance according to their families.
translations.ron: Iată împărţirea pe care a făcut-o Moise fiilor lui Israel, după seminţiile lor, în şesurile Moabului, dincolo de Iordan în faţa Ierihonului: Seminţiei fiilor lui Ruben, după familiile ei, Moise i-a dat parte:
translations.grk: Καὶ ἔδωκε Μωυσῆς τῇ φυλῇ Ῥουβὴν κατὰ δήμους αὐτῶν.

verses.geez:
ወኮነ ፡ ደወሎሙ ፡ እምነ ፡ አሮኤር ፡ እንተ ፡ መንገለ ፡ ቈላተ ፡ አርኖን ፡ ወሀገሮሂ ፡ ዘውስተ ፡ ቈላተ ፡ አርኖን ፡
                  ወኵሉ ፡ ሚሶር ፡ እስከ ፡ ሔሴቦን ።
verses.translation: And their borders were from Aroer, which is opposite the brook of Arnon, and theirs is the city that is in the valley of Arnon; and all Misor,

translations.lxx: And their borders were from Aroer, which is opposite the brook of Arnon, and theirs is the city that is in the valley of Arnon; and all Misor,
translations.kjv: And their coast was from Aroer, that is on the bank of the river Arnon, and the city that is in the midst of the river, and all the plain by Medeba;
translations.ron: Hotarele ei cuprindeau cetatea Aroer, care se află pe malul râului Arnon, la mijlocul cursului acestui râu şi tot şesul de lângă Medeba;
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐγενήθη αὐτῶν τὰ ὅρια ἀπὸ Ἀροὴρ, ἥ ἐστι κατὰ πρόσωπον φάραγγος Ἀρνῶν, καὶ ἡ πόλις ἡ ἐν τῇ φάραγγι Ἀρνῶν· καὶ πᾶσαν τὴν Μισὼρ,

verses.geez: ወኵሉ ፡ አህጉር ፡ ዘሀለወ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ሚሶር ፡ ወዴቦን ፡ ወበሞን ፡ ወበዓል ፡ ወአብያት ፡ ሜዔልሞት ።
verses.translation: to Esebon, and all the cities in Misor, and Dæbon, and Bæmon-Baal, and the house of Meelboth;

translations.lxx: to Esebon, and all the cities in Misor, and Dæbon, and Bæmon-Baal, and the house of Meelboth;
translations.kjv: Heshbon, and all her cities that are in the plain; Dibon, and Bamothbaal, and Bethbaalmeon,
translations.ron: Heşbonul şi toate cetăţile lui cele din şes; Dibonul, Bamot-Baal şi Bet-Baal-Meon;
translations.grk: ἕως Ἐσεβὼν, καὶ πάσας τὰς πόλεις τὰς οὔσας ἐν τῇ Μισὼρ, καὶ Δαιβὼν, καὶ Βαιμὼν Βαὰλ, καὶ οἴκου Μεελβὼθ,

verses.geez: ወባሳን ፡ ወበቄድሞን ፡ ወሜፋት ።
verses.translation: and Basan, and Bakedmoth, and Mæphaad,

translations.lxx: and Basan, and Bakedmoth, and Mæphaad,
translations.kjv: And Jahaza, and Kedemoth, and Mephaath,
translations.ron: Iahţa, Chedemot şi Mefaat;
translations.grk: καὶ Βασὰν, καὶ Βακεδμὼθ, καὶ Μαιφαὰδ, καὶ, Καριθαὶμ,

verses.geez: ወቃርያትም ፡ ወሴባማ ፡ ወሴራዶት ፡ ወሲዮን ፡ በደብረ ፡ ኤነብ ።
verses.translation: and Kariathaim, and Sebama, and Serada, and Sion in mount Enab;

translations.lxx: and Kariathaim, and Sebama, and Serada, and Sion in mount Enab;
translations.kjv: And Kirjathaim, and Sibmah, and Zarethshahar in the mount of the valley,
translations.ron: Chiriataim, Sibma şi Ţeret-Haşahar, în muntele Emec;
translations.grk: καὶ Σεβαμὰ, καὶ Σεραδὰ, καὶ Σιὼν ἐν τῷ ὄρει Ἐνὰβ,

verses.geez: ወቤተ ፡ ፌጎር ፡ ወኤሴዶት ፡ (ወ)ፈስጋ ፡ ወኤቤታነሲኖት ።
verses.translation: and Bæthphogor, and Asedoth Phasga, and Bætthasinoth,

translations.lxx: and Bæthphogor, and Asedoth Phasga, and Bætthasinoth,
translations.kjv: And Bethpeor, and Ashdothpisgah, and Bethjeshimoth,
translations.ron: Bet-Peor, locurile de la poalele muntelui Fazga şi Bet-Ieşimot;
translations.grk: καὶ Βαιθφογὼρ, καὶ Ἀσηδὼθ Φασγὰ, καὶ Βαιτθασεινὼθ,

verses.geez:
ወኵሉ ፡ አህጉረ ፡ ሚሶር ፡ ወኵሉ ፡ መግሥተ ፡ ሴዎን ፡ ንጉሠ ፡ አሞሬዎን ፡ ዘቀተለ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ ወመሳፍንተ ፡ [ምድያም
                  ፡] ወኤዊን ፡ ወሮቦ[ቅ] ፡ ወሱር ፡ ወኡር ፡ ወሮቤ ፡ መሳፍንተ ፡ ጰራሊያ ፡ ወእለ ፡ ይነብሩ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ሲዮን ።
verses.translation: and all the cities of Misor, and all the kingdom of Seon king of the Amorites, whom Moses smote, even him and the princes of Madian, and Evi, and Roboc, and Sur, and Ur, and Robe prince of the spoils of Sion, and the inhabitants of Sion.

translations.lxx: and all the cities of Misor, and all the kingdom of Seon king of the Amorites, whom Moses smote, even him and the princes of Madian, and Evi, and Roboc, and Sur, and Ur, and Robe prince of the spoils of Sion, and the inhabitants of Sion.
translations.kjv: And all the cities of the plain, and all the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites, which reigned in Heshbon, whom Moses smote with the princes of Midian, Evi, and Rekem, and Zur, and Hur, and Reba, which were dukes of Sihon, dwelling in the country.
translations.ron: Toate cetăţile din şes şi toată împărăţia lui Sihon, regele Amoreilor, care a domnit la Heşbon şi pe care l-a ucis Moise, ca şi pe căpeteniile lui Madiam, pe Evi, Rechem, Ţur, Hur şi Reba, căpeteniile lui Sihon, care locuiau în ţara aceea;
translations.grk: καὶ πάσας τὰς πόλεις τοῦ Μισὼρ, καὶ πᾶσαν τὴν βασιλείαν τοῦ Σηὼν βασιλέως τῶν Ἀμοῤῥαίων, ὃν ἐπάταξε Μωυσῆς αὐτὸν καὶ τοὺς ἡγουμένους Μαδιὰμ, καὶ τὸν Εὐὶ, καὶ τὸν Ῥοβὸκ, καὶ τὸν Σοὺρ, καὶ τὸν Οὒρ, καὶ τὸν Ῥοβὲ ἄρχοντα ἔναρα Σιὼν, καὶ τοὺς κατοικοῦντας Σιών.

verses.geez: ወበላዓም ፡ ወልደ ፡ ቤዖር ፡ ዘመቅሰም ፡ ቀተልዎሙ ፡ በምዕር ።
verses.translation: And Balaam the son of Bæor the prophet they slew in the battle.

translations.lxx: And Balaam the son of Bæor the prophet they slew in the battle.
translations.kjv: Balaam also the son of Beor, the soothsayer, did the children of Israel slay with the sword among them that were slain by them.
translations.ron: De asemenea şi pe Valaam, fiul lui Beor, vrăjitorul, l-au ucis fiii lui Israel cu sabia, în numărul celor ucişi de ei.
translations.grk: Καὶ τὸν Βαλαὰμ τὸν τοῦ Βαιὼρ τὸν μάντιν ἀπέκτειναν ἐν τῇ ῥοπῇ.

verses.geez:
ወኮነ ፡ ደወሎሙ ፡ ለሮቤል ፡ (ወ)ዮርዳንስ ፡ ወሰኖሙ ፡ ወዝንቱ ፡ መክፈልቶሙ ፡ ለደቂቀ ፡ ሮቤል ፡ በቦ ፡ ነገዶሙ ፡
                  ወአህጉሪሆሙኒ ።
verses.translation: And the borders of Ruben were—even Jordan was the boundary; this is the inheritance of the children of Ruben according to their families, these were their cities and their villages.

translations.lxx: And the borders of Ruben were—even Jordan was the boundary; this is the inheritance of the children of Ruben according to their families, these were their cities and their villages.
translations.kjv: And the border of the children of Reuben was Jordan, and the border thereof. This was the inheritance of the children of Reuben after their families, the cities and the villages thereof.
translations.ron: Hotarul fiilor lui Ruben era Iordanul. Aceasta e partea fiilor lui Ruben după familiile lor, după cetăţile şi satele lor.
translations.grk: Ἐγένετο δὲ τὰ ὅρια Ῥουβὴν, Ἰορδάνης ὅριον· αὑτη ἡ κληρονομία υἱῶν Ῥουβὴν κατὰ δήμους αὐτῶν, αἱ πόλεις αὐτῶν καὶ αἱ ἐπαύλεις αὐτῶν.

verses.geez: ወወሀቦሙ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ ለደቂቀ ፡ ጋድ ፡ በበ ፡ ነገዶሙ ።
verses.translation: And Moses gave inheritance to the sons of Gad according to their families.

translations.lxx: And Moses gave inheritance to the sons of Gad according to their families.
translations.kjv: And Moses gave inheritance unto the tribe of Gad, even unto the children of Gad according to their families.
translations.ron: De asemenea a dat Moise parte seminţiei lui Gad, fiilor lui Gad, după familiile lor.
translations.grk: Ἔδωκε δὲ Μωυσῆς τοῖς υἱοῖς Γὰδ κατὰ δήμους αὐτῶν.

verses.geez:
ወኮነ ፡ ደወሎሙ ፡ ኢያዜር ፡ [ወ]ኵሉ ፡ አህጉረ ፡ ገላአድ ፡ ወመንፈቀ ፡ [ምድረ ፡] ደቂቀ ፡ ዐሞን ፡ እስከ ፡ ዐራባ
                  ፡ እንተ ፡ ቅድመ ፡ ገጸ ፡ አራድ ።
verses.translation: And their borders were Jazer, all the cities of Galaad, and half the land of the children of Ammon to Araba, which is before Arad.

translations.lxx: And their borders were Jazer, all the cities of Galaad, and half the land of the children of Ammon to Araba, which is before Arad.
translations.kjv: And their coast was Jazer, and all the cities of Gilead, and half the land of the children of Ammon, unto Aroer that is before Rabbah;
translations.ron: În hotarele lor se cuprindea Iezerul şi toate cetăţile Galaadului şi jumătate din ţara fiilor lui Amon,
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐγένετο τὰ ὅρια αὐτῶν Ἰαζήρ· πᾶσαι πόλεις Γαλαὰδ, καὶ τὸ ἥμισυ γῆς υἱῶν Ἀμμῶν ἕως Ἄραβα, ἥ ἐστι κατὰ προσωπον Ἀράδ.

verses.geez:
ወእምነ ፡ ሔሴቦን ፡ እስከ ፡ [አ]ራቦት ፡ እንተ ፡ መንገለ ፡ መሴፋ ፡ ወቦጣኒ ፡ ወማዐን ፡ እስከ ፡ ደወሎሙ ፡ ለዴቦን
                  ።
verses.translation: And from Esebon to Araboth by Massepha, and Botanim, and Maan to the borders of Dæbon,

translations.lxx: And from Esebon to Araboth by Massepha, and Botanim, and Maan to the borders of Dæbon,
translations.kjv: And from Heshbon unto Ramathmizpeh, and Betonim; and from Mahanaim unto the border of Debir;
translations.ron: Până la Aroer, care e în faţa cetăţii Raba şi ţara de la Heşbon până la Ramat-Miţpa şi Betonim şi de la Mahanaim până la hotarele Debirului;
translations.grk: Καὶ ἀπὸ Ἐσεβὼν ἕως Ἀραβὼθ κατὰ τὴν Μασσηφὰ, καὶ Βοτανὶμ, καὶ Μαὰν ἕως τῶν ὁρίων Δαιβὼν,

verses.geez:
ወበአዶም ፡ ወዖትርጋ ፡ ወዐበይን ፡ ዘትነብራ ፡ ወሴኮታ ፡ ወሳፈን ፡ ወባዕድኒ ፡ ዘተርፈ ፡ መንግሥቱ ፡ ለሴዎን ፡ ንጉሠ
                  ፡ ሔሴቦን ፤ ወዮርዳንስ ፡ ወሰኖሙ ፡ እስከ ፡ አሐዱ ፡ ሕብር ፡ ዘባሕረ ፡ ኬኔሬት ፡ በማዕዶተ ፡ ዮርዳንስ ፡ ጽባሓዊ ።
verses.translation: and Enadom, and Othargai, and Bænthanabra, and Soccotha, and Saphan, and the rest of the kingdom of Seon king of Esebon: and Jordan shall be the boundary as far as part of the sea of Chenereth beyond Jordan eastward.

translations.lxx: and Enadom, and Othargai, and Bænthanabra, and Soccotha, and Saphan, and the rest of the kingdom of Seon king of Esebon: and Jordan shall be the boundary as far as part of the sea of Chenereth beyond Jordan eastward.
translations.kjv: And in the valley, Betharam, and Bethnimrah, and Succoth, and Zaphon, the rest of the kingdom of Sihon king of Heshbon, Jordan and his border, even unto the edge of the sea of Chinnereth on the other side Jordan eastward.
translations.ron: În vale i-a dat Bet-Haram, Bet-Nimra, Sucot şi Ţafon, rămăşiţa regatului lui Sihon, regele Heşbonului. Hotarul lui era Iordanul până la marea Chineret, întinzându-se de la Iordan spre răsărit.
translations.grk: καὶ Ἐναδὼμ καὶ Ὀθαργαῒ καὶ Βαινθαναβρὰ καὶ Σοκχωθὰ καὶ Σαφὰν καὶ τὴν λοιπὴν βασιλείαν Σηὼν βασιλέως Ἐσεβών· καὶ ὁ Ἰορδάνης ὁριεῖ ἕως μέρους τῆς θαλάσσης Χενερὲθ πέραν τοῦ Ἰορδάνου ἀπʼ ἀνατολῶν.

verses.geez:
ወዝንቱ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ መክፈልቶሙ ፡ ለደቂቀ ፡ ጋድ ፡ በበ ፡ ነገዶሙ ፤ ወሜጡ ፡ ዘባኖሙ ፡ ቅድመ ፡ ፀሮሙ ፡ እስመ ፡ በበ
                  ፡ ነገዶሙ ፡ ኮነ ፡ አህጉሪሆሙኒ ፡ ወደብረ ፡ አህጉሪሆሙኒ ።
verses.translation: This is the inheritance of the children of Gad according to their families and according to their cities: according to their families they will turn their backs before their enemies, because their cities and their villages were according to their families.

translations.lxx: This is the inheritance of the children of Gad according to their families and according to their cities: according to their families they will turn their backs before their enemies, because their cities and their villages were according to their families.
translations.kjv: This is the inheritance of the children of Gad after their families, the cities, and their villages.
translations.ron: Aceasta era partea fiilor lui Gad după familiile lor, cetăţile şi satele lor.
translations.grk: Αὕτη ἡ κληρονομία υἱῶν Γὰδ κατὰ δήμους αὐτῶν καὶ κατὰ πόλεις αὐτῶν· κατὰ δήμους αὐτῶν αὐχένα ἐπιστρέψουσιν ἐναντίον τῶν ἐχθρῶν αὐτῶν, ὅτι ἐγενήθη κατὰ δήμους αὐτῶν αἱ πόλεις αὐτῶν, καὶ αἱ ἐπαύλεις αὐτῶν.

verses.geez: ወወሀቦሙ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ ለመንፈቀ ፡ ነገደ ፡ መናሴ ፡ በበ ፡ ሕዘቢሆሙ ።
verses.translation: And Moses gave to half the tribe of Manasse according to their families.

translations.lxx: And Moses gave to half the tribe of Manasse according to their families.
translations.kjv: And Moses gave inheritance unto the half tribe of Manasseh: and this was the possession of the half tribe of the children of Manasseh by their families.
translations.ron: Şi a mai dat Moise parte şi la jumătate din seminţia lui Manase, adică la jumătate din seminţia fiilor lui Manase, după familiile lor.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἔδωκε Μωυσῆς τῷ ἡμίσει φυλῆς Μανασσῆ κατὰ δήμους αὐτῶν.

verses.geez:
ወኮነ ፡ ደወሎሙ ፡ እምነ ፡ መሐና ፡ ወኵሉ ፡ መንግሥተ ፡ ባሳን ፡ ወኵሉ ፡ መንግሥተ ፡ አግ ፡ ንጉሠ ፡ ባሳን ፡ ወኵሉ
                  ፡ አህጉረ ፡ ኢያኢር ፡ እለ ፡ ሀለዋ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ባሳን ፡ ስሳ ፡ አህጉር ።
verses.translation: And their borders were from Maan, and all the kingdom of Basan, and all the kingdom of Og king of Basan, and all the villages of Jair, which are in the region of Basan, sixty cities:

translations.lxx: And their borders were from Maan, and all the kingdom of Basan, and all the kingdom of Og king of Basan, and all the villages of Jair, which are in the region of Basan, sixty cities:
translations.kjv: And their coast was from Mahanaim, all Bashan, all the kingdom of Og king of Bashan, and all the towns of Jair, which are in Bashan, threescore cities:
translations.ron: În hotarele lor se cuprindea tot Vasanul de la Mahanaim, toată împărăţia lui Og, regele Vasanului, şi toate sălaşurile Iairului celui din Vasan, şaizeci de cetăţi.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐγένετο τὰ ὅρια αὐτῶν ἀπὸ Μαὰν, καὶ πᾶσα βασιλεία Βασὰν, καὶ πᾶσα βασιλεία Ὢγ βασιλέως τῆς Βασὰν, καὶ πάσας τὰς κώμας Ἰαῒρ, αἵ εἰσιν ἐν τῇ Βασανίτιδι, ἑξήκοντα πόλεις.

verses.geez:
ወመንፈቀ ፡ ምድረ ፡ ገላአድ ፡ ወበአስጣሮት ፡ ወበኤ(ን)ድራይን ፡ አህጉረ ፡ መንግሥቱ ፡ ለአግ ፡ እለ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ባሳን
                  ፡ ለደቂቀ ፡ ማኪር ፡ ትውልደ ፡ መናሴ ፡ ወለመንፈቆሙሂ ፡ ለደቂቀ ፡ ማኪር ፡ ዘትውልደ ፡ መናሴ ፡ በበ ፡ ሕዘቢሆሙ ።
verses.translation: and the half of Galaad, and in Astaroth, and in Edrain, royal cities of Og in the land of Basan, Moses gave to the sons of Machir the sons of Manasse, even to the half-tribe sons of Machir the sons of Manasse, according to their families.

translations.lxx: and the half of Galaad, and in Astaroth, and in Edrain, royal cities of Og in the land of Basan, Moses gave to the sons of Machir the sons of Manasse, even to the half-tribe sons of Machir the sons of Manasse, according to their families.
translations.kjv: And half Gilead, and Ashtaroth, and Edrei, cities of the kingdom of Og in Bashan, were pertaining unto the children of Machir the son of Manasseh, even to the one half of the children of Machir by their families.
translations.ron: Iar jumătate din Galaad cu Aştarotul şi Edrea, oraşele nepotului lui Og al Vasanului, au fost date fiilor lui Machir, fiul lui Manase, la jumătate din fiii lui Machir după familiile lor.
translations.grk: Καὶ τὸ ἥμισυ τῆς Γαλαάδ· καὶ ἐν Ἀσταρὼθ, καὶ ἐν Ἐδραῒν πόλεις βασιλείας Ὢγ ἐν τῇ Βασανίτιδι, τοῖς υἱοῖς Μαχὶρ υἱοῖς Μανασσῆ, καὶ τοῖς ἡμίσεσιν υἱοις Μαχὶρ υἱοῖς Μανασσῆ, κατὰ δήμους αὐτῶν.

verses.geez:
[*እሉ ፡ እሙንቱ ፡ እለ ፡*] አስተዋረሶሙ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ በማዕዶተ ፡ ዮርዳንስ ፡ በአራቦት ፡ ዘሞአብ ፡ በማዕዶተ ፡
                  ዮርዳንስ ፡ ዘመንገለ ፡ ጽባሒሁ ፡ ለኢያሪኮ ።
verses.translation: These are they whom Moses caused to inherit beyond Jordan in Araboth Moab, beyond Jordan by Jericho eastward.

translations.lxx: These are they whom Moses caused to inherit beyond Jordan in Araboth Moab, beyond Jordan by Jericho eastward.
translations.kjv: These are the countries which Moses did distribute for inheritance in the plains of Moab, on the other side Jordan, by Jericho, eastward.
translations.ron: Iată ce a dat Moise ca parte de moştenire în şesul Moabului, peste Iordan, în faţa Ierihonului spre răsărit.
translations.grk: Οὗτοι οὓς κατεκληρονόμησε Μωυσῆς πέραν τοῦ Ἰορδάνου ἐν Ἀραβὼθ Μωὰβ ἐν τῷ πέραν τοῦ Ἰορδάνου τοῦ κατὰ Ἱεριχὼ ἀπʼ ἀνατολῶν.
